caveats: A sprawling complex rather than a discrete object, and permanently under construction, so it is the least object-like subject in the set.

Regenerated 2026-08-03. Earlier attempts gave a flat relief (from a facade-filling frame) and then four detached spires over nothing; this input is far enough back that the nave and the facade carry the massing, so the towers now stand on a building.
